{{Top|leg}}
The '''Type-B Homing Mine''' was a type of [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. These warheads traveled at extremely high speeds, and were powerful enough to destroy an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in a single blow. They were most notably used by [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[AA-23]], which had been stolen by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] double agent [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kupalo]].
